selection_method: Top 10 sovereign-country 2025 territorial GHG emitters in EDGAR 2026; not ranked toxicity or culpability

countries.name: China
countries.research_entry_point: Permits and disclosed pollution categories; construct time-valid corporate ownership graph
countries.key_gaps: Scale facility discharges, concentrations, non-climate health pathways, regional access

countries.name: United States
countries.research_entry_point: Facility-level TRI reporting and ECHO compliance chronology
countries.key_gaps: Resolve hazardous-substance thresholds, downstream transport, injury and jurisdiction

countries.name: India
countries.research_entry_point: NGT judgments and agency records as first-stage research leads
countries.key_gaps: Need a verified facility-release portal, local unit standards, geocoded sites

countries.name: Russia
countries.research_entry_point: NVOS facility identity and federal registration metadata
countries.key_gaps: Public measurable release files, access constraints, source independence

countries.name: Indonesia
countries.research_entry_point: PROPER compliance criteria and company-level assessment leads
countries.key_gaps: Primary release quantities, parent ownership, site coordinates, appeal status

countries.name: Brazil
countries.research_entry_point: IBAMA inspection notices, environmental embargoes and official data
countries.key_gaps: Notice finality, industrial pollutant quantities, watershed causal chain

countries.name: Iran
countries.research_entry_point: Territorial and asset-estimated climate baselines only
countries.key_gaps: Public environmental release register and jurisdiction-specific counsel research unverified

countries.name: Japan
countries.research_entry_point: Japan PRTR chemical-release and transfer disclosures
countries.key_gaps: Link company/facility identifiers and outcome-specific human/ecological effects

countries.name: Saudi Arabia
countries.research_entry_point: Country emissions and asset-level climate estimation baseline
countries.key_gaps: Verified local industrial release and enforcement records missing from catalogue

countries.name: Canada
countries.research_entry_point: NPRI facility-level air/water/land and cross-program data
countries.key_gaps: 2025 NPRI preliminary data; use reviewed vintages for comparisons
